PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.QuickStep.De: Effect: The creature Steps. It then gains a +10-foot status bonus to its land Speed for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.DefensiveBra: Trigger: The creature is targeted by an attack. Effect: It braces against the blow, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack and until the start of its next turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.MenacingDisp: Effect: The creature threatens one creature within 30 feet that can see or hear it. The target attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failed save it becomes frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical failure. It is then immune to Menacing Display for 10 minutes.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.Pounce.Name: Pounce
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.Pounce.Descr: Effect: The creature Strides and makes a melee Strike at the end of that movement. If it begins Pounce hidden, it remains hidden until after the Strike. If it has the appropriate Speed, it can Fly, Burrow, Climb, or Swim instead of Striding.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.PackHunter.D: Effect: The creature’s Strikes deal 1d4 additional damage to a target that is within melee reach of at least two of the creature’s allies.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.TerrifyingRo: Effect: Each enemy in a 30-foot emanation that can hear the roar attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it becomes frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical failure. It is then immune to Terrifying Roar for 10 minutes.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.TailSweep.De: Effect: The creature sweeps its tail, body, or a similar limb through a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area attempts a Reflex save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it falls prone; on a critical failure it is also pushed 10 feet away from the creature. This is forced movement.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.DraconicMaje: Effect: While a frightened enemy is within 30 feet and can see the dragon, its frightened condition can’t decrease below 1.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.GraveChill.D: Effect: The creature makes a melee Strike. On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its land Speed for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.TerrifyingMo: Effect: Each living creature in a 30-foot emanation that can hear the moan attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it becomes frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical failure. It is then immune to Terrifying Moan for 10 minutes.
Effect: The incorporeal creature Strides up to its Speed. During this movement it can pass through creatures and solid objects; solid matter is difficult terrain. It must end the movement in an open space.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.Overdrive.De: Effect: The construct overloads its drive systems. The next Strike it hits with before the end of its turn deals 2 additional damage per weapon damage die.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.ReactivePlat: Trigger: The creature is targeted by an attack. Effect: Its armor shifts into place, granting a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack and until the start of its next turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.ElementalBur: Effect: The creature releases elemental force in a 15-foot emanation. Each other creature in the area attempts a basic Reflex save against the creature’s moderate DC and takes damage matching the creature’s dominant elemental affinity. Use the damage of its primary Strike as the damage benchmark.
Effect: The creature Strides up to its Speed along a line up to 30 feet long. Creatures in that line attempt a basic Reflex save against the creature’s moderate DC and take fire damage equal to the damage of its primary Strike.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.WhirlwindSte: Effect: A gust carries the creature up to 10 feet as a Step; this movement doesn’t trigger reactions caused by movement. It then gains a +10-foot status bonus to its land Speed for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.BeguilingGla: Effect: One creature within 60 feet attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it is dazzled for 1 round. On a critical failure it is blinded until the end of its next turn, then dazzled for 1 additional round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.CruelFeint.D: Effect: The fiend Feints against a creature in melee reach. On a success, the target is off-guard to the fiend’s melee attacks until the end of the fiend’s current turn; on a critical success this lasts until the end of its next turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.SoulPressure: Effect: One creature within 30 feet attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it takes a –1 status penalty to Will saves for 1 round; on a critical failure the penalty lasts 1 minute.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.GraspingRoot: Effect: Each enemy in a 15-foot emanation attempts a Reflex save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure its Speeds are reduced by 10 feet for 1 round. On a critical failure it is also immobilized until the end of its next turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.SporeFlash.D: Effect: The creature releases an irritating spore cloud in a 15-foot emanation. Each other creature in the area attempts a Fortitude save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it is dazzled for 1 round; on a critical failure it is blinded until the end of its next turn and then dazzled for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.EngulfingSla: Effect: The ooze makes a melee Strike. On a hit it partially folds around the target, which is off-guard until the start of the ooze’s next turn. On a critical hit the target is also grabbed until then unless it Escapes first.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.SwarmingAssa: Effect: The swarm Strides along a line up to 30 feet long and can move through other creatures’ spaces during this movement. Each creature whose space it passes through attempts a basic Reflex save against the swarm’s moderate DC and takes damage equal to the swarm’s primary Strike damage. A creature is affected only once per use.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.TacticalFein: Effect: The creature Feints against a creature in melee reach and can then Step. On a success, the target is off-guard to its melee attacks until the end of the creature’s current turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.CommandingSh: Effect: The creature chooses one ally within 30 feet that can hear the shout. That ally can immediately use its reaction to Step. This movement occurs outside the ally’s turn and, because it is a Step, doesn’t trigger reactions caused by movement.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.AstralDispla: Trigger: The creature takes damage from an attack. Effect: After the damage is resolved, the creature teleports up to 10 feet to an open space it can see. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions caused by movement.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Frightened1.D: Frightened 1 imposes a –1 status penalty to checks and DCs. Its value normally decreases by 1 at the end of the creature’s turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Hampered10.De: The creature’s land Speed is reduced by 10 feet for the duration of the effect.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.OffGuard.Desc: The creature is off-guard and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to AC.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Dazzled.Descr: Vision is impaired; creatures and objects are concealed to the affected creature.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Enfeebled1.De: Enfeebled 1 makes Strength-based physical actions 1 point less effective.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.QuickenedStep: The creature gains a +10-foot status bonus to its land Speed for the duration of the effect.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Guarded.Descr: The creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC for the duration of the effect.
The creature takes a –1 status penalty to Will checks for the duration of the effect.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Aura.DreadPresence.D: A menacing presence makes nearby enemies recoil in fear.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Aura.ScorchingPresen: Intense heat surrounds the creature and scorches nearby creatures.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Aura.SporeHaze.Name: Spore Haze
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Aura.SporeHaze.Descr: A cloud of dense spores makes it harder for nearby enemies to resist bodily strain.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Aura.StaticField.Des: Crackling electrical charge interferes with the movement of nearby enemies.
A protective field strengthens the defenses of the creature and its allies.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Affliction.PredatorV: A debilitating injury poison progressively weakens the victim’s muscles.
Necrotic corruption eats away at a living victim’s strength and health.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Affliction.SporeFeve: Aggressive fungal spores cause nausea and spread through the body.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Affliction.InfernalT: Unholy influence erodes the victim’s resolve and mind.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Loot.Salvage.Descrip: Usable remains recovered from this creature.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.DragonBreath: Effect: The creature unleashes its elemental breath weapon. Damage, damage type, area, and exact DC are listed under Mechanics; creatures in the area attempt the listed basic save. After use, the breath weapon can’t be used again for 1d4 rounds.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.WingBuffet.D: Effect: Each creature in a 15-foot cone attempts a Reflex save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it is pushed 5 feet and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round. On a critical failure it is pushed 10 feet, falls prone, and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round. This is forced movement.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.LifeDrain.De: Effect: The creature makes a melee Strike. On a hit, the target is enfeebled 1 for 1 round; on a critical hit it is enfeebled 2 for 1 round instead.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.DeathlessRec: Frequency: Once per day. Trigger: Damage would reduce the creature to 0 HP. Effect: The creature remains at 1 HP instead. This reaction can’t prevent death effects or effects that completely destroy the body.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.EmergencyRep: Frequency: Once per 10 minutes. Effect: The construct realigns damaged components and regains Hit Points equal to 10 + twice its level. This is repair rather than healing when an effect specifically distinguishes between the two.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.UnstableDisc: Effect: Each other creature in a 15-foot emanation attempts a Fortitude save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it is dazzled for 1 round; on a critical failure it is blinded until the end of its next turn and then dazzled for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.ElementalSur: Effect: The creature makes a Strike and floods it with its elemental affinity. On a hit, the Strike deals one additional damage die of the same size as its first damage die; the extra damage type matches the creature’s dominant elemental affinity.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.LivingHazard: Effect: The creature’s immediate surroundings are hazardous. An enemy that begins its turn within 5 feet or enters that area for the first time during its turn takes damage matching the elemental affinity equal to half the creature’s level, minimum 1. A creature can take this damage only once per round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.EntanglingTe: Effect: The creature chooses up to two creatures within 15 feet. Each target attempts a Reflex save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure its Speeds are reduced by 10 feet for 1 round. On a critical failure it is also immobilized until it Escapes or until the end of its next turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.SporeBloom.D: Effect: Each creature in a 15-foot cone attempts a Fortitude save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it becomes sickened 1, or sickened 2 on a critical failure.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.AdhesiveBody: Effect: When a creature hits the ooze with an unarmed melee Strike or successfully Grapples it, that creature attempts a Reflex save against the ooze’s moderate DC. On a failure it becomes grabbed until the end of its next turn unless it Escapes first. On a critical success it is immune to Adhesive Body until the end of its turn.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.CorrosiveSpl: Effect: Each other creature in a 10-foot emanation attempts a Reflex save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it takes acid damage equal to the creature’s level (minimum 1) and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round; on a critical failure it takes double damage and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.UnholyRebuke: Trigger: A creature within 30 feet damages this creature with an attack. Effect: The attacker attempts a Will save against the creature’s moderate DC. On a failure it becomes frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical failure.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.RadiantRebuk: Trigger: A creature within 30 feet damages this creature with an attack. Effect: The attacker attempts a Fortitude save against the creature’s moderate DC. On a failure it is dazzled for 1 round; on a critical failure it is blinded until the end of its next turn and then dazzled for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.PlanarCorrec: Effect: One creature within 60 feet attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round; on a critical failure stupefied 1 lasts for 1 minute.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.PsychicPulse: Effect: Each other creature in a 30-foot emanation attempts a Will save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round; on a critical failure it becomes stupefied 2 for 1 round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.SpatialTwitc: Trigger: An attack against the creature misses. Effect: The creature teleports up to 10 feet to an open space it can see. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions caused by movement.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.SweepingBlow: Effect: The creature makes a melee Strike against up to two different creatures in a 15-foot cone. Both Strikes count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after both Strikes are made.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.HurlDebris.D: Effect: The creature hurls debris at a point within 60 feet, creating a 10-foot burst. Each creature in the area attempts a Reflex save against the creature’s high DC. On a failure it takes bludgeoning damage equal to the creature’s primary Strike damage and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round; on a critical failure it also falls prone.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Clumsy1.Name: Clumsy 1
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Clumsy1.Descr: The creature gains the clumsy 1 condition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Sickened1.Des: The creature gains the sickened 1 condition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Stupefied1.De: The creature gains the stupefied 1 condition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Slowed1.Name: Slowed 1
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Slowed1.Descr: The creature gains the slowed 1 condition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.DragonBrea: Direct damage from the breath weapon. The GM adjudicates the basic save and degree of success.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Drained1.Name: Drained 1
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Drained1.Desc: The creature gains the drained 1 condition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.TrollRegener: Effect: The creature regenerates the number of Hit Points listed under Mechanics each round. Acid or fire damage deactivates this regeneration until the end of the creature’s next turn. Apply the linked effect to the creature to activate the regeneration mechanically.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.VampiricDrai: Requirement: The creature has the target grabbed or restrained. Effect: It makes a jaws or other appropriate melee Strike against the target. On a hit, the target becomes drained 1 and the creature gains the temporary Hit Points listed under Mechanics.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.HydraHeads.D: Effect: The creature has the number of independent heads and reactions per round listed under Mechanics. Extra reactions from this ability can be used only for reactions involving a head or a melee Strike made with a head. Severed heads can regrow at the GM’s discretion.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.PhoenixRebir: Frequency: Once. Trigger: The creature dies. Effect: After the delay listed under Mechanics, it returns with the listed percentage of its maximum HP. The listed fire burst occurs at the same time, and creatures in the area attempt the listed basic Reflex save.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.ElementalRet: Trigger: A creature within the emanation listed under Mechanics damages this creature. Effect: Its elemental core discharges. Creatures in the area attempt the basic save listed under Mechanics and take the listed elemental damage. Elemental Retaliation can be used only once per round.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.TrollRegen: The creature’s regeneration. Acid or fire damage deactivates it according to the PF2e regeneration effect.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.VampiricDr: The creature gains temporary Hit Points from stolen vitality.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.PhoenixReb: Direct fire damage from the rebirth flame. The GM adjudicates the basic save and resurrection.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.ElementalR: Direct damage from elemental retaliation. The GM adjudicates the basic save.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Title: Mythic
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Role.Label: Mythic role
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Role.Hint: Automatic maps the normal creature role to a mythic role template.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Ambus: Uses the extreme skill value for Stealth.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Hazar: Does not trigger hazard reactions in its own lair and ignores damaging area effects created by those hazards.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Bruti: Uses the extreme skill value for Athletics.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Feroc: Cost 1 Mythic Point. When reduced to 0 HP, remain conscious at half maximum HP and increase wounded by 1. This cannot be used at wounded 3.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Titan: Ignores size limitations for actions such as Grapple or Trip.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Devas: Uses the high spell DC and spell attack modifier for its level, or extreme values from level 11 onward.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Mythi: Uses the extreme skill value for the skill associated with its magical tradition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Deadl: After moving at least 10 feet with Stride, Burrow, Climb, or Fly, the next Strike deals 1d6 additional precision damage.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Mobil: Uses the extreme skill value for Acrobatics.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Resil: The listed saving throws are treated as one degree of success better than rolled.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Resis: Resistance against Strikes made by non-mythic creatures. Mythic weapons bypass it.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Defen: An attacker that rolls a critical hit must reroll the attack and use the new result.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Immun: Immunity to the selected category of non-mythic attacks or spells.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.MythicS: Cost 1 Mythic Point. The next selected skill check gains +4 and uses mythic proficiency.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.RemoveC: Cost 1 Mythic Point. End one condition currently affecting the creature.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.Recharg: Cost 1 Mythic Point. Gain another use of a spell or ability that normally has limited uses.
Cost 1 Mythic Point. Regain a spent spell use.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.Undying: Spend all remaining Mythic Points when the creature would die. It remains conscious and regains 50% of its maximum HP.
Cost 1 Mythic Point after failing a check. Reroll the check and use the new result.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.Unimped: Cost 1 Mythic Point. End a circumstance penalty to Speed; Escape automatically succeeds against immobilized, grabbed, or restrained.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Editor.AbilityFocusH: Selected tags increase the selection weight of matching abilities. They are preferences, not hard filters, and only apply to eligible abilities from enabled libraries.
